title: Tebak Hantu
description: {name} reads out a line and you guess which of the four ghosts said it. Ten new lines every day, and a streak of right answers pays extra.

how.en: Read the line, then tap the ghost you think said it. Ten lines a day, the same for everyone. Right answers in a row earn bonus points.
how.id: Baca kalimatnya, lalu ketuk hantu yang menurutmu mengucapkannya. Sepuluh kalimat per hari, sama untuk semua orang. Jawaban benar beruntun dapat poin bonus.

en: Hihi, they all sound alike in the dark! Try again, I want to see you get it!
Ooh, so many mix-ups! Which ones fooled you? Tell me, tell me!
id: Hihi, di gelap suaranya mirip semua! Coba lagi, aku pengen liat kamu bisa!
Ooh, banyak yang ketuker! Yang mana yang nipu kamu? Cerita dong!

en: Not bad at all! You have been listening to us, haven't you? Nosy, I like it!
Ooh, you know us pretty well! What else do you know? Spill!
id: Lumayan banget! Kamu nyimak kami ya? Kepo, aku suka!
Ooh, kamu lumayan kenal kami! Tau apa lagi? Ceritain!

en: WOW, you know every one of us! Have you been eavesdropping on ME?!
Perfect ears! Okay, I need to know your secret, right now!
id: WAH, kamu kenal kami semua! Jangan-jangan kamu nguping aku?!
Telinga sempurna! Oke, aku harus tau rahasiamu, sekarang!

en: A new best!! I am telling everyone, the branches, the well, everybody!
Record!! Hihihi, I knew you were the nosy kind, just like me!
id: Rekor baru!! Aku kabarin semua orang, dahan, sumur, semuanya!
Rekor!! Hihihi, aku tau kamu tipe kepo juga, kayak aku!

id.description: {name} membacakan satu kalimat dan kamu menebak hantu mana dari empat hantu yang mengucapkannya. Sepuluh kalimat baru tiap hari, dan jawaban benar beruntun dapat bonus.
